headline: Empire Strikes Back Yoda Hand Sells For $15,000
post:
The left hand from the original Yoda puppet in Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back recently sold at Heritage Auctions for $15,000. 

Controlled and voiced by Frank Oz, the foam latex prop includes the exact spot where the Jedi Master held his cane. C-3PO's prop glove even went for more at $17,500.

Would you pay $15,000 for Yoda's cane hand or hold out for his swamp-lifting right hand? 

#StarWars #Yoda #HeritageAuctions
original_title: Yoda Could Lend You a Hand, and This Piece of His Original Empire Strikes Back Puppet Makes It Possible

headline: Robert Pattinson Batman Contract Changes
post:
Frequent delays to The Batman Part II reportedly allowed Robert Pattinson to slip out from under his contract for a third film. According to a source, the star no longer has a contractual obligation to return for a third outing as the caped crusader.

Production setbacks and leadership changes at Warner Bros. have stretched the timeline for the sequel out significantly. Warner Bros. could still create a new deal for him to return if the sequel achieves major success.

Will Robert Pattinson return for a third movie or leave Gotham behind?

#TheBatman #DC #RobertPattinson
original_title: Robert Pattinson’s Batman Future May Already Be Over Before He Was Cast as James Bond

headline: Mister Terrific becomes a New God
post:
DC Comics is shaking up the universe in a major way for the Justice League. According to Screen Rant, a surprising character is taking on a massive new villainous role. Michael Holt is stepping up to godhood and sitting triumphantly on an upside-down Omega-shaped throne, according to the solicitation for Justice League Unlimited #27. 

After absorbing the team's complete collection of superpowers in issue #22, his brilliant intellect turns clinical and ruthless. Without a selfless heart to temper his calculations, pure logic convinces him that authoritarian control is the most efficient way to fix a broken universe. 

This dramatic heel turn leads him to understand Darkseid's ideology, making him a fascinating new equal to the ruler of Apokolips. Batman, who has handled similar cosmic upgrades without letting godhood seduce him into ruling, stands as one of the few who can hold him back.

Are you ready to see Michael Holt take on this dark new path?

#JusticeLeague #MisterTerrific #DCComics
original_title: A Classic Justice League Hero Is Officially Replacing Darkseid In Two Months

headline: Vision was almost a 1940s hero
post:
Get ready for a wild piece of comic book history. According to /Film, writer Roy Thomas originally wanted to revive a 1940s Golden Age character named Aarkus, an interdimensional being also known as the Vision, to join the Avengers. However, Stan Lee reportedly insisted on an android hero instead, leading Thomas and John Buscema to create the modern synthezoid we know today in "Avengers" #57. 

Thomas reportedly preferred bringing back older heroes because he did not want to invent new characters that he wouldn't own. Even though Lee allegedly disliked the name and the red skin color, this creative pivot changed Marvel history forever. The resulting character led to iconic storylines like his romance with the Scarlet Witch and his intense family dynamic with his creator, Ultron. 

It is wild to think how different the MCU might look if that 1940s character had taken the spot instead. Would you have wanted to see the original Aarkus join the team?

#MarvelHistory #Vision #Avengers
original_title: Marvel's Vision Was Originally Intended As A Revival Of A Forgotten Superhero
